rationale: Used isolated implementation and fresh-context review lanes because the durable runtime crosses network, retention, provenance, and crash-recovery boundaries.
Used deterministic focused and full test suites for acceptance and kept live source calls, database writes, deployment, and promotion out of the implementation lanes.

alternatives_rejected.reason: The local model was reserved for lower-risk bounded work; this high-risk durability and retention boundary required independently reviewed host-agent implementation.
Independent review found and drove repairs for candidate validation, incomplete-run resume, and quarantine retention edge cases.
Adapter transport was excluded until the runtime, FDA parity, merged source set, and execution storage boundary are separately accepted.

validation.method: Independent fresh-context runtime and boundary review

escalation_history: Independent review rejected the first implementation until persisted candidate invariants, truncated status, corrupt artifact handling, and original failure status were repaired.
Independent review rejected the first repair until expired partial failures preserved halt semantics and quarantined candidate content obeyed bounded retention.
